title: ELF3 (E74 like ETS transcription factor 3) promotes tumor growth and autophagy in pancreatic cancer.
authors: Shang, Yuru; Zhang, Pingping; Yang, Yanhui; Fan, Yibao; Yang, Zhichao; Sun, Hongshi; Wang, Jia; Yu, Zhengming; Wu, Jiale; Wang, Wenxu; Kahlert, Ulf Dietrich; Sethi, Gautam; Linnebacher, Michael; Chen, Zhe-Sheng; Klionsky, Daniel J; Zhang, Xianbin
journal: Journal of experimental & clinical cancer research : CR
one_liner_zh: 该文研究胰腺癌中转录因子ELF3通过调控ATG10促进自噬和肿瘤生长，并用分子对接筛选抑制剂，但核心是肿瘤生物学而非TF-DNA互作机制建模，方法仅简单对接，与课题关联有限。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Despite the research progress of the past decades, the prognosis for pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma remains poor. Identifying novel targets and exploring the underlying mechanisms is therefore of great importance. ELF3 (E74 like ETS transcription factor 3) is a member of the E-twenty-six (ETS) family and previous studies suggest that ELF3 may play a promoting role in malignant epithelial tumor; however, the effect and exact mechanism have not been determined in pancreatic cancer. METHODS: ELF3 expression and its prognostic relevance in pancreatic cancer were analyzed using clinical datasets. The role of ELF3 in autophagy regulation was evaluated using molecular and cellular approaches in vitro and in vivo. Computer-aided drug design was performed to identify potential ELF3 inhibitors, whose anti-tumor efficacy was subsequently evaluated. RESULTS: In the present study, it is observed that high expression of ELF3 leads to a poor overall survival in pancreatic cancer patients. Functional experiments demonstrated that knockdown of ELF3 blocks autophagy. In addition, SRT2183 was identified as a potential ELF3 inhibitor using molecular docking. In vitro and in vivo results showed that SRT2183 blocks autophagy and exerts anti-carcinoma effect. CONCLUSIONS: These findings demonstrate that ELF3 promotes autophagy through transcriptional regulation of ATG10 and identify ELF3 as a potential therapeutic target in pancreatic cancer. SRT2183, an ELF3-targeting compound that suppresses autophagic flux and tumor growth, represents a promising candidate for further therapeutic development.
abstract_zh: 背景：尽管过去几十年研究取得了进展，但胰腺导管腺癌的预后仍然较差。因此，识别新靶点并探索其潜在机制具有重要意义。ELF3（E74样ETS转录因子3）是E-twenty-six（ETS）家族的一员，既往研究表明ELF3可能在恶性上皮性肿瘤中发挥促进作用；然而，其在胰腺癌中的作用及确切机制尚未明确。方法：利用临床数据集分析ELF3在胰腺癌中的表达及其预后相关性。通过体外和体内分子及细胞学方法评估ELF3在自噬调控中的作用。采用计算机辅助药物设计识别潜在的ELF3抑制剂，并随后评估其抗肿瘤疗效。结果：本研究发现，ELF3高表达与胰腺癌患者总生存期较差相关。功能实验表明，敲低ELF3可阻断自噬。此外，通过分子对接将SRT2183鉴定为潜在的ELF3抑制剂。体外和体内结果显示，SRT2183可阻断自噬并发挥抗肿瘤作用。结论：这些发现表明，ELF3通过转录调控ATG10促进自噬，并将ELF3确定为胰腺癌的潜在治疗靶点。SRT2183作为一种靶向ELF3的化合物，可抑制自噬流和肿瘤生长，是进一步治疗开发的 promising 候选药物。
